properties.headline: Coastal Flood Watch issued November 22 at 5:24AM PST until November 26 at 1:00PM PST by NWS San Diego CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, minor coastal flooding
expected. For the Coastal Flood Watch, significant coastal
flooding possible.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, from 4 AM Sunday to 4
AM PST Tuesday. For the Coastal Flood Watch, from 4 AM PST
Tuesday through Thursday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Numerous roads may be closed. Low lying property
including homes, businesses, and some critical infrastructure
may be inundated. Some shoreline erosion may occur.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Morning high tides will be on the increase
this upcoming week. Highest tides will be Tuesday through
Thursday, peaking Wednesday. Daily high tides each morning on
Tuesday through Thursday will reach 7.9-8.2 feet, likely re-
breaking the all time tidal records set back in late October.
Background surf on top of the tides will remain around 3-5 feet
through Wednesday, but an incoming swell Wednesday into Thursday
could bring notably higher surf beginning on Thursday.
Uncertainty remains in exact surf heights at this time, but look
to be 6-8 feet with sets up to 10 feet on west-facing beaches.
properties.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.
